sources.imageryCredit: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 79 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: The operator identifies the former 3.9 km main course before the 2024 reconstruction. This 3924.9 m pinned 2023 source route retains the Northern narrow return, central hairpin, Eastern technical return and Southern triangular sector. Later extensions, pit access and adjacent karting are excluded. Direction and fine historical corner alignment remain draft. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

notes: The independent 2023 Western closure joins the Northern narrow loop to the Southern triangular sector through the central connection. The 2641 m source route remains a descriptively named historical draft; current operator Medium course distances follow later reconstruction and are not substituted for this trace. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.
